snippet.title: Beellionaire Idle – Demo Out Now Trailer | Cozy Beekeeping Incremental Game
snippet.description:
🐝 The Bee-llionaire Idle Demo is OUT NOW!
Start with a single hive and build your way toward a buzzing honey empire in Bee-llionaire Idle  a cozy first-person incremental game blending hands-on beekeeping, satisfying production and gradual automation.
Smoke and open your hives, collect honey-filled frames, process and bottle your honey, expand your farm, unlock upgrades and turn a humble apiary into an efficient production facility.
🍯 Harvest and process honey by hand
🌼 Water flowers to boost honey production
⚙️ Unlock machines and automation
📦 Improve storage and transportation
🏡 Expand your farm with new hives and production areas
💤 Earn more through incremental and offline progression  
Play the free demo and wishlist the full game on Steam:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4970630/Beellionaire_Idle/
Developed by Ravenholm Interactive.
🌐 https://ravenholminteractive.co/
💼 https://www.linkedin.com/company/ravenholm-interactive/
If you enjoyed the demo, wishlist the game, leave your feedback and share the trailer with another future honey tycoon!
#BeeLlionaireIdle #IndieGame #CozyGame #IdleGame #IncrementalGame #SimulationGame #Beekeeping #SteamDemo
